prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A warmly lit classroom scene set in what appears to be a Middle Eastern or North African school, with sunlight streaming softly through two large windows draped with sheer curtains. The room is filled with young girls, all wearing matching school uniforms consisting of white shirts and dark pinafores, some with headscarves. The focal point is a girl standing at her desk in the center of the room, her expression earnest and attentive as she addresses the teacher or the class. Around her, other students sit at wooden desks, engaged in various activities—some writing, some looking towards the standing girl, others glancing at their books or each other. The classroom walls are adorned with educational posters, including a large, colorful illustration of a castle and a palm tree, and a bulletin board with papers pinned to it. The overall color palette is warm and muted, with soft beige walls, natural wood tones, and gentle sunlight creating a nostalgic, cinematic atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to subtly blur the background, drawing attention to the central figure and her classmates, while the camera angle is slightly elevated, offering a comprehensive view of the classroom’s lively yet studious ambiance.
